map.PIN 码的安全性完全取决于位数与随机性。n 位纯数字 PIN 的组合空间为 1: A PIN's security comes entirely down to its length and randomness. For an n-digit numeric PIN the combination space is 10ⁿ: 4 digits gives only 10,000, easily brute-forced or guessed; 6 digits gives 1,000,000, the common floor for bank cards and phone unlock codes. This tool draws each digit uniformly at random with crypto.getRandomValues, avoiding the predictable bias of Math.random. Always pair it with an attempt limit and a lockout policy — however strong the randomness, unlimited attempts will be exhausted.

map.4 位仅 1 万组合，需配合锁定策略。: A 4-digit PIN has only 10,000 combinations, so a lockout policy is essential.
map.为什么不能用生日当 PIN？: Why is a birthday a bad choice for a PIN?
map.因为生日属于可枚举的弱信息：攻击者只需尝试有限范围内的日期组合（约 366 种: Because a birthday is weak, enumerable information: an attacker only needs to try date combinations within a limited range (about 366, plus year variants), which succeeds far more often than random guessing. By the same logic, avoid common patterns such as 1234, 0000 and 1111, as well as fragments of ID or phone numbers. Only a randomly generated PIN is uniformly distributed.
